place.en: North of the Si · in the mist

setup.zh: 你沿泗水北行。雾里立着一只白鹿，头生四角。
setup.en: You follow the river north. In the mist stands a white deer with four antlers.

text.zh: 雾里立着夫诸。古书上说，它出现的地方会发大水。
text.en: Fuzhu stands in the mist. The old books say floods follow wherever it appears.
It neither backs away nor comes closer.

exits.means: gives or feeds it an herb, especially the lingzhi

refuse.en: You have no lingzhi on you.

text.zh: 你摊开掌心，递上那株灵芝。夫诸低头嗅了嗅，四只角在雾里轻轻一晃，把灵芝衔走了。
text.en: You open your palm and hold out the lingzhi. Fuzhu lowers its head, sniffs, and with a slow sway of its four antlers takes the herb from your hand.
…You are not afraid of me. Very well — I will go with you.
…Human, you are more interesting than you look.

exits.means: fights it, challenges it, tries to subdue or drive it off

withdrawn.zh: 夫诸隐入雾中。明日再来。
withdrawn.en: Fuzhu has withdrawn into the mist. Come back tomorrow.

text.en: …You win. I will go with you.

exits.means: avoids it or goes around it

text.zh: 你绕开了它。它在雾里看了你很久，没有走。
text.en: You go around it. It watches you from the mist for a long time, and does not leave.

exits.means: tries to touch, pet or grab it

text.zh: 夫诸退了一步，不让你碰。
text.en: Fuzhu steps back. It will not let you touch it.
